beyaynetu-fasting-combo.title: Beyaynetu (Fasting Combo)
beyaynetu-fasting-combo.text: A colorful platter of assorted vegan dishes served on injera, perfect for fasting and sharing. Ingredients: Injera, shiro, misir wat, gomen, tikil gomen, salad.

misir-wat.title: Misir Wat
misir-wat.text: Spicy red lentil stew cooked with berbere, onions, and garlic. Ingredients: Red lentils, onion, garlic, berbere, oil.

gomen-besiga.title: Gomen Besiga
gomen-besiga.text: Collard greens cooked with tender beef and Ethiopian spices. Ingredients: Collard greens, beef, onion, garlic, oil.

firfir-injera-stir-fry.title: Firfir (Injera Stir Fry)
firfir-injera-stir-fry.text: Shredded injera mixed with spicy berbere sauce, often served with meat or vegetarian. Ingredients: Injera (torn), berbere sauce, onion, oil.

dulet.title: Dulet
dulet.text: Finely chopped tripe, liver, and beef mixed with spices and chili. Ingredients: Beef tripe, liver, minced beef, onion, chili.

chechebsa.title: Chechebsa
chechebsa.text: Traditional Oromo breakfast dish made from flatbread pieces mixed with butter and berbere. Ingredients: Flatbread, niter kibbeh, berbere, honey.

genfo.title: Genfo
genfo.text: Thick porridge served with spiced butter and berbere sauce. Ingredients: Barley flour, water, niter kibbeh, berbere sauce.

shiro.title: Shiro
shiro.text: Creamy chickpea flour paste with onions, ginger, and Ethiopian spices. Ingredients: Chickpea flour, onion, ginger, garlic, oil.

chicken-alfredo-pasta.title: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
chicken-alfredo-pasta.text: Creamy pasta dish with grilled chicken and rich Alfredo sauce. Ingredients: Fettuccine pasta, chicken breast, cream, parmesan cheese, garlic.

margherita-pizza.title: Margherita Pizza
margherita-pizza.text: Classic Italian pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella, and fresh basil. Ingredients: Pizza dough, tomato sauce, mozzarella, basil leaves.

french-fries-with-chicken-wings.title: French Fries with Chicken Wings
french-fries-with-chicken-wings.text: Crispy fries served with spicy fried chicken wings. Ingredients: Potatoes, chicken wings, flour, oil, spices.

club-sandwich.title: Club Sandwich
club-sandwich.text: Triple-layer sandwich with chicken, bacon, lettuce, and tomato. Ingredients: Bread, chicken, bacon, lettuce, mayonnaise.

fish-and-chips.title: Fish and Chips
fish-and-chips.text: Deep-fried fish served with crispy fries and tartar sauce. Ingredients: Fish fillet, potatoes, flour, oil, lemon.

caesar-salad.title: Caesar Salad
caesar-salad.text: Fresh salad with lettuce, croutons, cheese, and creamy dressing. Ingredients: Lettuce, croutons, parmesan, Caesar dressing.

beef-shawarma-wrap.title: Beef Shawarma Wrap
beef-shawarma-wrap.text: Middle Eastern wrap filled with spiced beef and vegetables. Ingredients: Flatbread, beef strips, garlic sauce, tomato, lettuce.

rice-with-grilled-fish.title: Rice with Grilled Fish
rice-with-grilled-fish.text: Steamed rice served with seasoned grilled fish and vegetables. Ingredients: Rice, fish, lemon, garlic, vegetables.

ethiopian-coffee.title: Ethiopian Coffee
ethiopian-coffee.text: Traditional coffee brewed from freshly roasted beans with rich aroma. Ingredients: Coffee beans, water, sugar (optional).

mango-juice.title: Mango Juice
mango-juice.text: Fresh and sweet mango blended into a refreshing drink. Ingredients: Mango, water, sugar.

avocado-juice.title: Avocado Juice
avocado-juice.text: Creamy and nutritious blended avocado drink. Ingredients: Avocado, milk, sugar.

soft-drinks.title: Soft Drinks
soft-drinks.text: Chilled carbonated beverages served cold. Ingredients: Soda, ice.

lemon-mint-juice.title: Lemon Mint Juice
lemon-mint-juice.text: Refreshing drink with lemon and fresh mint. Ingredients: Lemon, mint leaves, water, sugar.

chocolate-cake.title: Chocolate Cake
chocolate-cake.text: Rich and moist chocolate cake topped with creamy frosting. Ingredients: Flour, cocoa powder, sugar, eggs, butter.

fruit-salad.title: Fruit Salad
fruit-salad.text: Fresh seasonal fruits mixed together with light syrup. Ingredients: Apple, banana, mango, orange, honey.

ice-cream.title: Ice Cream
ice-cream.text: Creamy frozen dessert available in different flavors. Ingredients: Milk, cream, sugar, flavoring.

baklava.title: Baklava
baklava.text: Sweet pastry layered with nuts and honey syrup. Ingredients: Phyllo dough, nuts, honey, butter.

pancakes-with-honey.title: Pancakes with Honey
pancakes-with-honey.text: Soft pancakes served with honey or syrup. Ingredients: Flour, milk, eggs, honey, butter.

sambusa-ethiopian-appetizer.title: Sambusa (Ethiopian Appetizer)
sambusa-ethiopian-appetizer.text: Crispy pastry filled with spiced lentils or minced meat, deep-fried to golden perfection. Ingredients: Sambusa wraps, lentils or minced meat, onion, garlic, oil, spices.

chicken-soup.title: Chicken Soup
chicken-soup.text: Warm and comforting soup with tender chicken, vegetables, and herbs. Ingredients: Chicken, carrot, potato, garlic, water, salt & pepper.

garlic-bread.title: Garlic Bread
garlic-bread.text: Toasted bread topped with garlic butter and herbs. Ingredients: Bread, butter, garlic, parsley.

spring-rolls.title: Spring Rolls
spring-rolls.text: Crispy rolls stuffed with vegetables or chicken. Ingredients: Spring roll wrappers, vegetables, chicken (optional), oil, soy sauce.

avocado-salad.title: Avocado Salad
avocado-salad.text: Fresh avocado mixed with vegetables and light dressing. Ingredients: Avocado, tomato, onion, lemon juice, olive oil.
